text:
Anya Chen: Quick pass — noticed the create-key modal still shows 'Save secret' CTA even when ephemeral key selected.
Mike R.: ah yeah that confuses people. Should be 'Copy secret' vs 'Download' depending on ephemeral vs persistent.
Samir: Agree. Also the warning copy for org keys uses 'sensitive' — maybe stronger: 'Do not share — anyone with this key can access all models'.
Kate L.: +1. For screen readers the 'show secret' button needs aria-pressed and an announce: 'Secret revealed' toast.
Anya Chen: Good catch. Current toast just says 'Key created' — we should add role=alert and announce the copy action.
design-bot: Accessibility check: Contrast on the warning banner fails AA at small sizes. Suggest using #b02e2e for icon/background.
Mike R.: Hmm, would that clash with primary danger color? Maybe use a left border rather than full bg to reduce visual noise.
Samir: UX flow question — when rotating a key, we prompt to download old secret. That feels risky. Suggest: create new key, show both rotate timeline and a 24h grace period before invalidating old key.
Kate L.: +1 on grace. Also add an inline checklist: 'Update integrations', 'Revoke after verification' — helps users plan.
Eve: Copy tweak proposal for modal body: "Generate a new API key for integrations. You will see the secret once — store it securely." Shorter: "You will see this secret only once. Store it now." Which is clearer?
Anya Chen: I prefer the shorter. Also remove passive voice: replace 'You will see' -> 'This secret is shown only once.'
Mike R.: For empty states in credentials page, current illustration is cute but lacks guidance. Add two CTA buttons: 'Create API key' and 'Learn about scopes' (link to docs).
Samir: About scopes — we should show a compact matrix in the create flow listing model access vs actions (generate, embeddings). Helps set expectations.
Kate L.: One more a11y nit: keyboard focus order on the rotate modal jumps from primary CTA to footer link — needs linear tab order.
Anya Chen: I'll update the Figma with revised copy, CTA labels: primary 'Download secret' (when persistent), alternative 'Copy secret' for ephemeral. Add a subtle caution row for org keys: 'Requires org admin to revoke'.
Eve: Can we add microcopy under the permission selector: 'This key can access all org data' when admin-scoped. Keep in red text but not full banner.
Mike R.: Sounds good. I'll prototype the border-only warning and test contrast. Samir, can you draft the 24h grace UX and edge-case flows (webhooks, scheduled jobs)?
Samir: On it. I'll post a small flow doc and a screenshot of the timeline.
Anya Chen: Thanks everyone — let's try to have a quick sync tomorrow after your mocks. :thumbsup:
